origin: Regenerated using original seed-17 generators and recovered held-out base programs. Original missing files were not available for byte comparison. Runtime-dependent gate decisions may change coverage.

L0.description: Normalized original. Comments/docstrings stripped, 4-space indent, LF endings.

L1b.description: Adversarial/misleading renaming of ALL bindings including the entry function. Names drawn from semantic-inversion tables (max->min, prime->composite) and a plausible-but-unrelated domain vocabulary (the fibfib->smoothArea trap).

L1r.description: Random hex renaming of all bindings — v_<4hex> for variables, f_<4hex> for functions.

L2.description: Maximal identifier destruction: sequential minification (a, b, c, ... aa, ab) of all bindings + type-annotation stripping. Doubles as the alpha-equivalence canonicalizer for dedup (corpus/dedup.py).

S1.description: Control-flow flattening of the entry function body into a dispatch loop with randomized non-sequential state ids and shuffled case order.

S2.description: Opaque predicates (always-false/always-true guards) + never-called dead helpers.

S3.description: Dead-code insertion ONLY (proposal X2) — 1-2 never-called module-level helpers, without S2's opaque predicates. Split out of S2 so a degradation can be attributed to one mechanism: a dead helper only has to be IGNORED, whereas an opaque predicate has to be REASONED ABOUT, and S2 fuses the two.

S4.description: Opaque predicates ONLY (proposal X3) — 1-3 computed always-taken/never-taken guards at reachable statement boundaries of the entry function, without S2's dead helpers. The guard EXECUTES and its predicate must be evaluated; contrast S5, whose guard is a literal constant and therefore statically dead.

X1.description: TRAINABLE SIBLING OF H1 (W6 lever 7, 2026-09-04). Same two mechanisms as H1 — every str literal through an inline decoder, every + - ^ through a type-guarded algebraic helper, int literals expanded — built from a DIFFERENT scheme: XOR'd codepoint lists decoded by `_rs`, and the complementary identities a+b=(a|b)+(a&b), a-b=(a^b)-2(~a&b), a^b=(a+b)-2(a&b) in `_ar_p/_ar_m/_ar_x`. Emits nothing on h1_marker_patterns, so the gate scan and check_manifest apply unchanged. Python only. REPORTED IN ITS OWN NAMESPACE: an adapter that saw X1 has seen the H1 family, so it is never pooled with the headline systems and any H1 read of it is a human decision that spends the final pass.

X1m.description: E6 MECHANISM ABLATION (2026-09-07): X1 with ONLY the MBA-arithmetic half -- every + - ^ through the type-guarded algebraic helpers and int literals expanded; string literals untouched. Same generator, same RNG stream, `mechanisms: [mba]`. Asks which half of the X1/H1 family carries the transfer. Own namespace, like X1.

X1s.description: E6 MECHANISM ABLATION (2026-09-07): X1 with ONLY the string-encoding half -- every str literal through the inline `_rs` decoder; arithmetic untouched. `mechanisms: [str]`. The complement of X1m. Own namespace, like X1. SITE BAR IS 1, NOT 3: at X1's bar of 3 only 7/40 sampled programs have enough string literals, which would make the X1s training set a "programs with many strings" subset -- a confound. The primary E6 read is on FULL X1 items (same items for every system), so X1s's own coverage is secondary.

X2.description: TRAINABLE member of a SECOND family pair (E5, 2026-09-07). Every `return <expr>` and every `if`/`while` test is routed through a raised-and-caught `LookupError` carrying the value in `.args[0]`, via identity helpers `_thru`/`_guard`. The family -- "follow the value out through the exception machinery and back" -- is distinct from renaming (L1b/L1r/L2), dispatch flattening (S1), inert material (S2) and encoding (X1/H1). Its sibling is Y2. Python only. Reported in its own namespace.

Y2.description: THE UNSEEN SIBLING of X2, and EVAL-ONLY (E5, 2026-09-07). Same family, different surface: the value crosses the boundary as `StopIteration.value` off a generator `return`, read back by `_pull`/`_sel`. Never trained on -- an adapter that has seen Y2 voids the E5 comparison. NOT quarantined the way H1 is, and the difference matters: H1 was the paper's single discriminator with a two-read budget, whereas Y2 is regenerable from src/obtune/obf/py/xy2.py at any time, so a re-read costs nothing and forecloses nothing. That is also why Y2 EXTENDS the family evidence rather than replacing H1's.

H1.description: HELD OUT. String encoding (base64 + inline decoder / RC4 string array) plus guarded mixed-boolean-arithmetic rewriting of + - ^ operators.
